subject: assistant e2e broken on shared since c8fd8c3-ish: 'Ask Naadi' textbox never renders + inline-stylesheet CSP refusal
body: Local stack, prod build, --retries=0: assistant.spec.ts 108/150/183(both)/237/277/329 fail on WebKit iPad portrait and Chromium laptop at f3a7168 (no S22 commits on top), pass at 44561bf. Symptom: getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Ask Naadi' }) not found; the prod-CSP test also logs 'Refused to apply a stylesheet because its hash, its nonce, or unsafe-inline does not appear in the style-src directive' on /learn/ch01/ch01-s01 — something now injects a <style> element (style-src has no unsafe-inline; do not add it). Between those commits the only assistant change is c8fd8c3 (review14). Please take a look.
